channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Trama golpista: STF encerra fase de recursos e já executou as penas de todos os condenados
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) concluded the appeals phase and ordered the execution of sentences for the 29 individuals convicted of the 2022 coup attempt led by Jair Bolsonaro. Of the convicted, 20 are in closed regime, 3 under house arrest, 3 are fugitives, 2 reached plea deals, and 1 is in open regime. Sentences range from 1 year and 11 months to 27 years and three months, including former ministers and high-ranking military officials.

item.title: Vídeo de 'fazenda de likes' de Flávio Bolsonaro e Nikolas Ferreira é IA
item.description: Social media posts falsely claim that a police operation uncovered a 'like farm' linked to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira. The content is misinformation, with no evidence of such a discovery by authorities.

item.title: Alckmin e ministro da Agricultura vão representar governo Lula na Agrishow
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Minister of Agriculture Carlos Fávaro will represent the Lula government at Agrishow, the agribusiness fair in Ribeirão Preto. The information was released by the Presidency's Secretariat of Social Communication.

item.title: Conselho de Ética analisa processo contra deputado bolsonarista que xingou Motta nesta terça-feira
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council will meet next Tuesday (28) to vote on the opinions regarding complaints against bolsonarist deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS), accused of insulting Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB). The allegations include slurs such as 'you piece of shit' and 'you bastard', along with remarks about Motta's physical appearance, during a protest that paralyzed the plenary for over 30 hours in August 2025. Penalties could include a 90-day suspension if the process is approved.

item.title: Motta cria comissão especial sobre o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta has created a special committee to analyze a constitutional amendment proposal to end the 6×1 work schedule, with 37 titular and 37 substitute members. The committee will discuss reducing the weekly workweek, while two PECs (by Reginaldo Lopes and Erika Hilton) and a government bill from Lula’s administration are simultaneously advancing, proposing 36- or 40-hour workweeks. Motta favors the constitutional amendment route to preserve Legislative leadership, aiming for a floor vote by the end of May.

item.title: Moraes decreta prisão domiciliar de condenada do núcleo 2 da trama golpista
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered house arrest for former federal delegate Marília Ferreira de Alencar, sentenced to eight years and six months for her role in the 2022 coup plot. She had already been under preventive house arrest with an electronic ankle monitor and led intelligence analyses in Nucleus 2 that supported Federal Highway Police actions to disrupt voter turnout in Northeastern municipalities. She was convicted of criminal organization and violent abolition of the democratic state, losing her federal police position.

item.title: Clica e Confirma ressalta campanhas do TSE para ampliar participação de jovens eleitores
item.description: The TSE, in partnership with UNICEF Brazil, launched campaigns to encourage youths aged 15 to 17 to obtain their first voter title, aiming to increase youth participation in the 2026 elections. Initiatives include inclusive activities, such as in Sergipe for youths with Down syndrome and in Paraná with students from Alto Piquiri, plus the 'Justice Electoral for All People' event on April 29, focused on accessibility and citizenship.

item.title: Governo bloqueia 28 plataformas de apostas preditivas
item.description: The Brazilian government blocked 28 predictive market platforms, declaring them illegal as they do not fit under betting laws or financial regulations. Economy Minister Dario Durigan announced the decision, citing joint analysis by the Central Bank, CVM, Ministry of Justice, and Anatel, which has already implemented the block. The government warns of financial harm to low-income populations due to lack of oversight and regulatory gaps.

item.title: “STF precisa mudar de nome ou as pessoas que estão lá”, diz Zema
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) harshly criticized the STF, stating it needs to 'change its name or the people who are there', accusing ministers of using their positions for personal enrichment. He argued the Court is acting in a biased and harmful manner to Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Ruas diz que 'respeita a decisão' de Zanin, mas aguarda 'com cautela' a posição final do STF sobre governo do Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL), president of the Rio de Janeiro State Legislative Assembly (Alerj), stated he respects the decision of Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin, who maintained Rio de Janeiro Tribunal of Justice President Ricardo Couto as acting governor, awaiting the final plenary ruling on the state executive succession. Despite his election to lead Alerj, Ruas emphasized that the change in assembly leadership does not automatically alter the legal situation, as the exceptional succession thesis has not yet been analyzed by Minister Luiz Fux. The PL leadership in Rio shows caution, believing there remains room to reverse the decision, as the merits of the ADI will be evaluated by the STF plenary.

item.title: Deputado aciona TCU para investigar uso de R$ 4,5 mi em acervo privado de Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Sanderson (PL-RS), vice-leader of the Opposition in the Chamber, filed a representation with the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) to investigate the alleged use of R$ 4.5 million in federal public funds for organizing the private archive of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The action seeks to assess potential irregularities in the allocation of these resources, as referenced in the filing.

item.title: A tentativa de CPI sobre investimentos suspeitos no futebol
item.description: Federal deputy Luciano Amaral (PSD-AL) is gathering signatures for a CPI to investigate national and foreign investors in Brazilian football, citing irregularities in the SAFs of Botafogo and Vasco, as well as Daniel Vorcaro’s investment — owner of Banco Master — in Futebol Forte União (FFU). The initiative suspects the use of professional football as a structure for suspicious or potentially illicit financial operations by investor groups. However, its chances of advancing are minimal due to a backlog of CPIs in the Chamber and the upcoming 2026 elections, which will likely shift lawmakers’ focus.

item.title: “Jeito PT de governar”, diz Ciro ao comentar prejuízo bilionário dos Correios
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) criticized the Lula government by linking the Correios' new billion-dollar loss to the 'PT way of governing', citing recurring failures in state-owned enterprise management. He argued the financial performance reflects a historical pattern of poor administration, reinforcing opposition narratives about inefficiency in public companies under Workers' Party rule.

item.title: Associação de delegados da PF critica fala de Lula sobre agentes que 'fingem trabalhar'
item.description: The Federal Police Delegates Association (ADPF) criticized statements by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who accused PF agents of 'pretending to work'. The association called the remarks unjust and damaging to the institution's image, emphasizing the dedication of its members in combating crime.

item.title: Lula retira lesão do couro cabeludo e deve repousar nos próximos dias
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a surgical procedure on Friday morning (24) in São Paulo to remove a scalp lesion. According to his doctor, Ricardo Kalil, who accompanies the president, the surgery was successful and Lula is expected to rest in the coming days.

item.title: Zanin reforça decisão e mantém presidente do TJ no governo do Rio
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto de Castro, president of the Rio de Janeiro State Court of Justice, must continue as interim governor until the STF plenary defines the electoral process for the temporary mandate. The decision upholds a prior injunction and rejects a request by newly elected Alerj president Douglas Ruas to assume power, preserving the current arrangement while the succession case following Cláudio Castro's resignation remains stalled due to a request for view.

item.title: Planalto vê como pouco provável ida de Lula a Congresso do PT
item.description: Lula's team says it is 'highly unlikely' he will attend the closing of the PT congress this Sunday (26), due to his recovery from recent head surgery. The assessment was shared by the Planalto press office on Thursday morning (24).

item.title: Novo embate com Trump anima PT, mas traz um risco para Lula e STF
item.description: Lula is again targeting Donald Trump to gain political capital, repeating a strategy that previously boosted his popularity during the U.S. tariff episode. The conflict escalated following the arrest and release of Alexandre Ramagem, a former deputy who sought refuge in the U.S., a situation quickly politicized by both governments. Analysts warn that the U.S. narrative benefits Bolsonaro supporters and that granting political asylum to Ramagem could be seen as a defeat for Lula and the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Associação de delegados critica fala de Lula sobre policiais que ‘fingem trabalhar’
item.description: The Federal Police Delegates Association criticized Lula's remarks about officers who 'pretend to work,' saying they disparage the force and oversimplify public security. The association noted only 53 delegates are assigned to other agencies (under 3% of total), stressing that the real issue is talent loss and declining interest in entrance exams. It argued that fighting organized crime requires investment in training and intelligence, not statements that weaken public discourse.

item.title: “Dinheiro público não é prêmio pra político”, diz Zema
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized on social media X the use of public funds as a privilege for government officials, stating that public money should not be seen as a reward for politicians. Without naming specific individuals or cases, his politically toned post focused on corruption within the public machine and alleged enrichment of public agents.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Lula não terá restrições médicas para campanha após cirurgia | TEMPO REAL
item.description: Lula will face no medical restrictions in actively participating in the 2026 election campaign following his recent surgery. His medical team confirmed he is fit to engage in public activities, including campaign events, travel, and debates, without significant limitations. This removes a potential concern about his ability to run or support candidates in next year's presidential election.

item.title: Campanha de Zema vai parar de postar vídeos satíricos sobre ministros do STF
item.description: The campaign of Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema announced it will stop publishing satirical videos criticizing ministers of the Federal Supreme Court (STF). The decision follows growing criticism over the aggressive and potentially inappropriate tone of such content. The full article is available only to subscribers of the outlet.

item.title: BC barra apostas preditivas sobre eleições, esportes e realities
item.description: The Central Bank banned predictive market operations tied to non-economic events such as elections, sports, and reality shows, stating they resemble unregulated gambling and pose risks of manipulation, money laundering, and threats to event integrity. The measure, part of CMN Resolution No. 5.298, restricts regulated financial trading to assets with economic-financial benchmarks, effectively excluding platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket from operating in Brazil.

item.title: Lula remove lesão causada por carcinoma basocelular; entenda este tipo de câncer de pele
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a procedure this morning to remove a lesion from his scalp, diagnosed as basal cell carcinoma, the most common and least aggressive form of skin cancer. The treatment was performed without complications, and there are no indications of serious health risks at this time.

item.title: “Se ele for preso, vira um mártir”: a jogada de Zema em meio à crise com Gilmar
item.description: Romeu Zema, a right-wing pre-candidate, intensified his confrontation with Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes by associating justices with recent scandals, in a popular appeal strategy rooted in anti-establishment rhetoric. According to columnist Robson Bonin, Zema aims to occupy an electoral space akin to Enéas and Fernando Collor, turning potential legal actions against him into political capital, as a possible arrest could martyr him and boost his visibility.

item.title: Sarney completa 96 anos e ganha bolo do Flamengo da família
item.description: Former Brazilian President José Sarney turned 96 on April 24, 2026, celebrating with a Flamengo-themed cake alongside family in São Luís. As the first civilian president after the military regime, a five-term senator, and nine-year Senate president, Sarney remains politically active in Maranhão and is regarded as a national historical figure. He is also the author of 123 books, a member of the Brazilian Academy of Letters, and plans to release his 124th book in 2025.

item.title: Associação de delegados da PF critica fala de Lula sobre agentes que ‘fingem trabalhar’
item.description: The Federal Police Delegates Association (ADPF) criticized President Lula's remarks about agents who 'pretend to work', stating that such statements unfairly disqualify officers and do not reflect reality, as only 53 delegates (less than 3%) are seconded to other agencies. The association emphasized that combating organized crime requires investment in training and intelligence, not rhetoric, and warned of talent drain, with 50 delegates leaving the PF in the last three years while only 104 joined.

item.title: Associação dos delegados rebate fala de Lula sobre chamar agentes que estão 'fingindo trabalhar'
item.description: The National Association of Federal Police Delegates (ADPF) criticized President Lula's remark calling federal police agents and delegates 'pretending to work,' stating that such statements disqualify officers and distract from structural issues in fighting organized crime. The ADPF emphasized the need for proper valuation, talent retention, and funding for the PF, and reiterated the importance of ongoing dialogue with the federal government to improve public security policies.

item.title: Zanin mantém desembargador como governador do Rio após eleição do presidente da Alerj
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Rio de Janeiro's Tribunal of Justice President, Judge Ricardo Couto, will continue as interim governor until the STF concludes its judgment on the state's executive elections, despite the election of Douglas Ruas (PL) as Alerj president. The decision upholds the prior order, rejecting the PSD's request for Ruas to assume the Guanabara Palace on an interim basis.

item.title: Zanin mantém presidente do TJ como governador do Rio
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled to keep Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice (TJ-RJ), in the role of state governor until the conclusion of the trial defining the model for the interim mandate election. The decision aims to ensure institutional stability while the method for filling the vacancy is debated.

item.title: A reação do STF para conter crise dos Poderes esbarra em um escândalo que não quer calar
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) is pursuing a political pact with Congress and the Presidency to ease an institutional crisis, led by Minister Gilmar Mendes in talks with the heads of the Chamber, Senate, and President Lula. The goal is to distribute responsibility and avoid perceptions that the crisis is solely the Court’s fault, rejecting an internal code of conduct as too politically costly. While Hugo Motta has signaled openness, skepticism remains due to electoral timing and uncertainty around Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s stance.

item.title: Conheça Rodrigo Saccone, novo assessor da pré campanha de Flávio
item.description: Rodrigo Saccone, a journalist with experience in media and government, has been appointed press advisor for Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential pre-campaign. He leaves his roles at Holding In.Pacto and STA Comunicação to lead campaign communications, pledging transparency and dialogue with the press. His background includes ministerial roles and political TV coverage, which he says prepares him for this new challenge.

item.title: A aposta de Haddad para começar a minar favoritismo de Tarcísio
item.description: Former minister Fernando Haddad, the PT’s pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, has outlined a strategy to weaken Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s frontrunner status, focusing on public security and controversies surrounding police conduct. Although Tarcísio leads in polls, Haddad’s performance has energized the PT, which sees him as a competitive ticket to support Lula’s 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio participarão da Agrishow no interior de SP
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will make his first public appearance in the 2026 presidential pre-campaign alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) at Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto on Monday, April 27. The event is strategically important for strengthening the right-wing alliance in the agribusiness sector, a key electoral battleground, and symbolizes a public unity between figures aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio’s appearance with Brazil’s most populous and wealthiest state governor reinforces his candidacy with substantial institutional backing.

item.title: Agente dos EUA deixa o Brasil após reação do governo Lula a medida de Trump
item.description: U.S. agent Michael Myers left Brazil after the Lula government applied the principle of reciprocity in response to the Trump administration's request for the withdrawal of a Brazilian Federal Police delegate operating in the U.S. Myers had been working since 2024 in intelligence cooperation between the PF and U.S. immigration authorities. His departure occurred before a formal order, following credential suspension, as a preventive measure while Brazil defined its official response.

item.title: Zanin decide que desembargador deve continuar como governador interino do Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice, must continue as interim governor until the STF plenary decides whether the succession will be indirect or direct. The PL had advocated for Douglas Ruas, president of the State Legislative Assembly, to assume office, while the PSD supported Couto’s continuation. The trial was suspended due to a view request by Flávio Dino and has no rescheduled date.

item.title: Gilmar, o camisa 10 da campanha de Zema
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Gilmar Mendes was described by allies of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema’s pre-campaign as the 'number 10' of Zema’s presidential bid, signaling his strategic influence. Zema’s team reports growing social media presence and believes endorsements from figures like Mendes strengthen his electoral viability.

item.title: TSE publica acórdão que estabelece renúncia de Cláudio Castro
item.description: The TSE published the ruling confirming that Cláudio Castro’s resignation as governor of Rio de Janeiro was voluntary, not due to cassation, thus ruling out direct elections for the temporary mandate. The TSE panel voted 4–1 in favor of indirect election, with only Minister Cristiano Zanin advocating for direct elections. The final decision rests with the STF, which is currently on hold due to a view request by Minister Flávio Dino.

item.title: Câncer basocelular, como o de Lula, é comum e tem alta taxa de cura
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was diagnosed with basal cell carcinoma on his scalp, the most common type of skin cancer, which has a high cure rate when detected and treated early. Experts note the tumor is linked to chronic UV radiation exposure, rarely metastasizes, and is unrelated to his prior laryngeal cancer history. Prevention includes sunscreen, hats, and protective clothing, particularly for those with baldness or thin hair.

item.title: Zanin decide que presidente do TJ deve ser mantido como governador do Rio mesmo após eleição de Ruas na Alerj
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice, must remain as interim governor despite Douglas Ruas being elected president of the state legislature. The decision affirms that Couto's role stems from a prior collegial STF ruling on the state election format, not an individual request. The PSD had sought reaffirmation of the ruling, while the Alerj had previously asked for Ruas to assume governorship.

item.title: Zanin diz que decisão do plenário que manteve Couto no governo do RJ permanece válida
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin upheld his March preliminary injunction, maintaining Ricardo Couto, president of the TJ-RJ, as acting governor of Rio de Janeiro, stating the plenary’s decision remains valid and requires no new ruling. Zanin also clarified that Douglas Ruas’s (PL) election as president of the Alerj does not alter the state’s succession line, as the governorship remains with Couto due to the executive vacancy following Cláudio Castro’s resignation and Rodrigo Bacellar’s removal.

item.title: Caiado prepara mudança para São Paulo e já ativa bases na capital e em Brasília
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is preparing to move to São Paulo in the coming weeks to intensify his presidential campaign, establishing his electoral headquarters in the city while maintaining a base in Brasília. The strategy aims to strengthen his presence in the Southeast and South regions, engage with business and financial sectors, and improve logistical access to key states such as Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Paraná.

item.title: Ministros do STF analisam acórdão do TSE sobre condenação de Castro para definir retomada de julgamento de eleição no Rio
item.description: STF ministers are reviewing the TSE's ruling on the conviction of former Rio governor Cláudio Castro to determine whether to resume the trial on the format of the state election. The debate centers on whether Castro's resignation, made just before the verdict, was an attempt to evade cassation and trigger an indirect election via the state legislature, or whether the vacancy should be treated as non-electoral, allowing Alerj to choose the successor under a suspended law. A key issue is whether diploma cassation is mandatory following a conviction for abuse of power, given that the TSE failed to secure a majority for cassation despite three votes in favor.

item.title: Lula passa por cirurgia para remover lesão cutânea da cabeça
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent successful surgery on Friday (24) in São Paulo to remove a skin lesion from his scalp. The procedure took place less than six months before the 2026 presidential elections, drawing attention to his health and potential implications for his campaign.

item.title: BC barra no Brasil mercados preditivos como Kalshi e Polymarket em eleições, esportes e reality shows
item.description: Brazil's Central Bank has banned the offering and trading within the country of derivatives tied to non-financial events such as elections, sports, reality shows, and social or cultural topics, under a new CMN resolution approved in April 2026 and effective May 4. The rule aims to protect investors, ensure transparency, and prevent harmful speculation, while allowing derivatives linked to verifiable economic and financial indicators. The CVM will issue complementary rules and oversee enforcement, including for foreign-traded products offered domestically.

item.title: Governo proíbe apostas esportivas, políticas e não financeiras em mercado preditivo e freia setor no país
item.description: The Brazilian federal government announced regulation of prediction markets, classifying them as fixed-odds betting requiring a license from the Ministry of Finance. The measure bans non-financial event betting—including sports, politics, reality shows, and wars—via derivative contracts, with the CVM overseeing enforcement. The rule, already partially enacted via a CMN resolution, prohibits derivative trading tied to non-economic-financial events, closing a regulatory loophole.

item.title: Procedimentos realizados por Lula não atrapalharão campanha, diz médico
item.description: Cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho stated that the surgical procedures undergone by President Lula will not interfere with his re-election campaign, as he is expected to resume normal activities within a few days, including a scheduled engagement on Monday.

item.title: É #FAKE que Lula rebateu Trump e disse que 'o povo brasileiro está disposto a dar a vida por ele em uma guerra'
item.description: It is false that President Lula rebuked Donald Trump by saying the Brazilian people are willing to give their lives for him in a war. The image used in the post is AI-generated with 95.5% probability of being fake, and no such statement exists in official government channels or Lula's social media.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio corteja as eleitoras
item.description: Women made up 53% of the electorate in the 2022 elections and voted predominantly for Lula (PT) over Jair Bolsonaro (PL), making the female vote a key strategic target for Senator and PL pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who aims to win over this demographic in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Margareth Menezes viaja para China para celebração de Ano Cultural
item.description: Culture Minister Margareth Menezes will travel to China from April 27 to May 3 to participate in the Brazil-China Cultural Year 2026. The mission includes meetings with Chinese officials, visits to cultural institutions such as the JZ Spring Festival in Shanghai and the Kuaishou platform, and performances by Brazilian artists including Ivan Lins and Adriana Calcanhotto. The goal is to strengthen cultural cooperation, the circulation of works, and the creative economy between Brazil and China.
